_note: Structured orbital-constants array for the Jupiter gravity-assist model (Node 2b input). The model code consumes ONLY this structured dict - source-agnostic, no ephemeris values hardcoded in the solver. Provenance: Node 1.5 Level 2 published planetary constants (Jupiter G=M_J*G; Galilean-moon a, M, P from standard ephemeris; G_J, M_J, R_J are textbook constants). All values in km / kg / s units as labeled.
capture_radius_note: a few R_J target; representative of a mid-range Jupiter capture orbit. The delta_v_required is sensitive to this; we use 100000 km (~1.4 R_J) as a representative value.
Isp_note: Representative chemical upper-limit Isp for a high-performance monoprop/hydrazine-class engine (300-450 s band). 350 s is the mid-band. This feeds the Tsiolkovsky residual-chemical-burn fraction.
